name: B10-0336/2025 (S&D) – Case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate release of Ryan Cornelius, a British man held in Dubai since 2008 over a property loan. It says he was arrested without a warrant, held alone and denied a lawyer, and that his prison time was extended by 20 years under a law passed after his arrest. It also says his health is poor and that the United Nations has already called his detention arbitrary. The Parliament asks the United Arab Emirates to free him, pay him compensation and investigate.

- What changes: nothing yet; the Parliament is asking the United Arab Emirates to act.
- Who it affects: Ryan Cornelius, his family and the United Arab Emirates authorities.
- What happens next: the resolution is sent to the United Arab Emirates and other bodies; his release is requested.
